comments.author: @ThePlanetDocumentary
comments.text: Scotland is truly magical! The breathtaking mountains, peaceful lochs, ancient castles, and charming villages make this country unforgettable. I love how this documentary captures not only the natural beauty but also the rich history and traditions of the Scottish people. Every scene feels peaceful and inspiring, reminding us how beautiful our world really is. Scotland has definitely become one of my dream destinations. Thank you for sharing this wonderful journey and helping us discover the hidden wonders of our planet! 🌍❤

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text: Thank you so much for such a beautiful and thoughtful comment! ❤ We’re delighted that the documentary inspired you to dream of visiting Scotland. There’s so much to discover beyond its famous landmarks, and we hope you get to experience its magic in person someday. Until then, we’re happy to take you along on the journey! 🌍🏴✨

comments.author: @CamotedeAventuras
comments.text: The Quiraing section stayed with me. A whole hillside still slowly sliding after an ancient landslide, with green plateaus and rock towers around it. And it's interesting that Aberdeen is built from granite that sparkles after rain. Beautiful film, and a good reminder that Scotland is more than the castles.

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text: Thank you so much for such a thoughtful comment! ❤ The Quiraing’s dramatic geology and Aberdeen’s sparkling granite are wonderful examples of Scotland’s beauty beyond its famous castles. We’re delighted those details stood out to you! 🏴✨
